news:quarg anywhere|"Yes, human? Do you have any questions?"|455|0
units.english: "Yes, human? Do you have any questions?"
units.italian: "Sì, umano? Hai qualche domanda?"

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|"Hello, human. Are you enjoying your time on our world? We are glad to receive visitors."|456|0
units.english: "Hello, human. Are you enjoying your time on our world? We are glad to receive visitors."
units.italian: "Salve, umano. Ti stai godendo il tempo passato sul nostro mondo? Siamo lieti di ricevere visitatori."

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|"I am sorry, but we will not provide you with our technology. It is for the best that humans grow and develop on their own."|457|0
units.english: "I am sorry, but we will not provide you with our technology. It is for the best that humans grow and develop on their own."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non ti forniremo la nostra tecnologia. È meglio che gli umani crescano e si sviluppino da soli."

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|"It troubles me greatly to see how many species still cling to senseless fighting. I can only hope you will all come to see reason."|458|0
units.english: "It troubles me greatly to see how many species still cling to senseless fighting. I can only hope you will all come to see reason."
units.italian: "Mi turba profondamente vedere quante specie si aggrappino ancora a una lotta insensata. Posso solo sperare che tutti voi arriviate a ragionare."

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|"Last year our scientific efforts were quite fruitful, but I am afraid we cannot simply share our discoveries with you."|459|0
units.english: "Last year our scientific efforts were quite fruitful, but I am afraid we cannot simply share our discoveries with you."
units.italian: "L'anno scorso i nostri sforzi scientifici sono stati piuttosto fruttuosi, ma temo che non possiamo semplicemente condividere le nostre scoperte con voi."

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|"If you ever observe some piece of our technology in the possession of someone else, please report it to us. We cannot allow our equipment to be in the wrong hands."|460|0
units.english: "If you ever observe some piece of our technology in the possession of someone else, please report it to us. We cannot allow our equipment to be in the wrong hands."
units.italian: "Se mai vedessi un pezzo della nostra tecnologia in possesso di qualcun altro, riferiscilo a noi. Non possiamo permettere che le nostre apparecchiature finiscano nelle mani sbagliate."

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|"You are welcome to be amongst us here, provided you seek no conflict with anyone on our worlds."|461|0
units.english: "You are welcome to be amongst us here, provided you seek no conflict with anyone on our worlds."
units.italian: "Sei il benvenuto fra noi, a patto che tu non cerchi conflitto con nessuno sui nostri mondi."

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|There's an eerie silence as a particularly large crowd of Quarg walks by you.|462|0
units.english: There's an eerie silence as a particularly large crowd of Quarg walks by you.
units.italian: C'è un silenzio inquietante mentre una folla insolitamente numerosa di Quarg ti passa accanto.

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|A group of Quarg is enthralled in what seems an engaging discussion, until one more Quarg comes to them. They all turn to it, and after it says something quickly they all get up in unison and move to somewhere else in the hangars.|463|0
units.english: A group of Quarg is enthralled in what seems an engaging discussion, until one more Quarg comes to them. They all turn to it, and after it says something quickly they all get up in unison and move to somewhere else in the hangars.
units.italian: Un gruppo di Quarg è assorto in quella che sembra una discussione coinvolgente, finché non si avvicina un altro Quarg. Si voltano tutti verso di lui e, dopo che ha detto qualcosa in fretta, si alzano all'unisono e si spostano altrove negli hangar.

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|An older Quarg is playing with a much younger Quarg, young enough that it's still shorter than yourself. The strange game consists of passing to one another a jar with some slimy, metallic substance inside. Every time the jar is passed, the substance meshes itself into a different shape, sometimes into shapes you know not the meaning of.|464|0
units.english: An older Quarg is playing with a much younger Quarg, young enough that it's still shorter than yourself. The strange game consists of passing to one another a jar with some slimy, metallic substance inside. Every time the jar is passed, the substance meshes itself into a different shape, sometimes into shapes you know not the meaning of.
units.italian: Un Quarg anziano gioca con un Quarg molto più giovane, tanto giovane da essere ancora più basso di te. Lo strano gioco consiste nel passarsi un barattolo che contiene una sostanza viscida e metallica. Ogni volta che il barattolo passa di mano, la sostanza si ricompone in una forma diversa, a volte in forme di cui non conosci il significato.

units.id: news:quarg anywhere|Dozens of Quarg children are being led around by a handful of adults, as if on a school trip. When they notice you, they continue taking glances and talking among themselves. It seems they've never seen a human before.|465|0
units.english: Dozens of Quarg children are being led around by a handful of adults, as if on a school trip. When they notice you, they continue taking glances and talking among themselves. It seems they've never seen a human before.
units.italian: Decine di piccoli Quarg vengono portati in giro da una manciata di adulti, come in una gita scolastica. Quando ti notano, continuano a lanciare occhiate e a parlare fra loro. Sembra che non abbiano mai visto un umano.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|You see a shorter, younger Quarg, likely a child in Quarg years, being shown around the ringworld by an adult. It seems like the parent is teaching the child about the ring.|481|0
units.english: You see a shorter, younger Quarg, likely a child in Quarg years, being shown around the ringworld by an adult. It seems like the parent is teaching the child about the ring.
units.italian: Vedi un Quarg più basso e più giovane, probabilmente un bambino in anni Quarg, a cui un adulto mostra il mondo ad anello. Sembra che il genitore stia insegnando al piccolo com'è fatto l'anello.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|A Quarg is standing uncomfortably close to the walls, tapping it slowly with both palms. You observe it for a few minutes, until it stops abruptly and goes about its business like the others.|482|0
units.english: A Quarg is standing uncomfortably close to the walls, tapping it slowly with both palms. You observe it for a few minutes, until it stops abruptly and goes about its business like the others.
units.italian: Un Quarg sta in piedi scomodamente vicino alle pareti e le tocca piano con entrambi i palmi. Lo osservi per qualche minuto, finché non si ferma di colpo e riprende le sue faccende come gli altri.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|Usual activity in the ringworld is stopped by a few dozen Quarg in heavily armored suits moving at a quick pace and escorting a large, tube-like container which floats to accompany them. Other Quarg are quick to make way for the group, allowing themselves a great distance from the armored Quarg.|483|0
units.english: Usual activity in the ringworld is stopped by a few dozen Quarg in heavily armored suits moving at a quick pace and escorting a large, tube-like container which floats to accompany them. Other Quarg are quick to make way for the group, allowing themselves a great distance from the armored Quarg.
units.italian: L'attività consueta nel mondo ad anello si ferma: qualche decina di Quarg in tute pesantemente corazzate avanza a passo rapido, scortando un grande contenitore tubolare che fluttua al loro fianco. Gli altri Quarg si affrettano a far largo al gruppo, tenendosi a grande distanza dai Quarg corazzati.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|Some Quarg scientists are dragging along a whole train of linked lab carts, packed fully with utensils, chemicals, components, and reagents. It takes nearly half an hour before you see the last of the carts pass by.|484|0
units.english: Some Quarg scientists are dragging along a whole train of linked lab carts, packed fully with utensils, chemicals, components, and reagents. It takes nearly half an hour before you see the last of the carts pass by.
units.italian: Alcuni scienziati Quarg si trascinano dietro un intero treno di carrelli da laboratorio agganciati fra loro, stipati di utensili, sostanze chimiche, componenti e reagenti. Passa quasi mezz'ora prima che tu veda sfilare l'ultimo carrello.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|Hundreds of Quarg are blocking one of the largest, widest corridors in the ring. They're all sitting down on the floor, staring down blankly in complete silence, with a scarce few seldom glancing up to the ceiling only to move their gaze downwards once again. You notice that Quarg who witness the scene stop all conversation and move elsewhere.|485|0
units.english: Hundreds of Quarg are blocking one of the largest, widest corridors in the ring. They're all sitting down on the floor, staring down blankly in complete silence, with a scarce few seldom glancing up to the ceiling only to move their gaze downwards once again. You notice that Quarg who witness the scene stop all conversation and move elsewhere.
units.italian: Centinaia di Quarg bloccano uno dei corridoi più grandi e larghi dell'anello. Sono tutti seduti a terra, lo sguardo fisso nel vuoto in totale silenzio, e solo pochissimi alzano di rado gli occhi al soffitto per poi riabbassarli. Noti che i Quarg che assistono alla scena smettono ogni conversazione e si spostano altrove.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|One Quarg walks up to you, and stares down into your eyes. It stays there in silence, just looking at you, before finally blinking once and moving along, disappearing into the ring's hallways.|486|0
units.english: One Quarg walks up to you, and stares down into your eyes. It stays there in silence, just looking at you, before finally blinking once and moving along, disappearing into the ring's hallways.
units.italian: Un Quarg ti si avvicina e ti fissa negli occhi. Resta lì in silenzio, a guardarti e basta, finché alla fine sbatte le palpebre una volta e prosegue, sparendo nei corridoi dell'anello.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|A Quarg is overseeing the unloading of dozens of ship-sized cargo containers that have arrived in the ring. It seems to mentally count the cargo as it's moved out in perfectly identical sets. After what must've been thousands of cargo tons, it clicks off one of dozens of small dots on a data pad and begins counting again.|487|0
units.english: A Quarg is overseeing the unloading of dozens of ship-sized cargo containers that have arrived in the ring. It seems to mentally count the cargo as it's moved out in perfectly identical sets. After what must've been thousands of cargo tons, it clicks off one of dozens of small dots on a data pad and begins counting again.
units.italian: Un Quarg sovrintende allo scarico di decine di container grandi come navi arrivati nell'anello. Sembra contare mentalmente il carico mentre viene estratto in gruppi perfettamente identici. Dopo quelle che devono essere state migliaia di tonnellate, spegne uno dei tanti puntini su un tablet e ricomincia a contare.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|Two Quarg ships land at the same time a few hangar bays away from one another. They open their hatches, and what must be the ships' entire crews come out. Without a hitch the crew of each ship boards the other's ship and depart.|488|0
units.english: Two Quarg ships land at the same time a few hangar bays away from one another. They open their hatches, and what must be the ships' entire crews come out. Without a hitch the crew of each ship boards the other's ship and depart.
units.italian: Due navi Quarg atterrano contemporaneamente a qualche baia di distanza l'una dall'altra. Aprono i portelli e ne escono quelli che devono essere gli equipaggi al completo. Senza intoppi l'equipaggio di ciascuna nave sale sull'altra e riparte.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|The Quarg seem to have set up some form of festival in the ring: endless stands stretch out as far as you can see, all displaying variations of the same orange-like fruit, ranging from impossibly smooth to unbelievably wrinkled, and also from sizes as small as a pea to as large as a watermelon. You can't figure what quality they like best.|489|0
units.english: The Quarg seem to have set up some form of festival in the ring: endless stands stretch out as far as you can see, all displaying variations of the same orange-like fruit, ranging from impossibly smooth to unbelievably wrinkled, and also from sizes as small as a pea to as large as a watermelon. You can't figure what quality they like best.
units.italian: I Quarg sembrano aver allestito una specie di festa nell'anello: bancarelle senza fine si stendono a perdita d'occhio, tutte con varianti dello stesso frutto simile a un'arancia, da incredibilmente liscio a incredibilmente grinzoso, e di dimensioni che vanno da un pisello a un cocomero. Non riesci a capire quale qualità preferiscano.

units.id: phrase:ringworld quarg phrases|You see one Quarg turn a sharp corner in what's a haste by their standards. When you look into the corridor it went to, you see it's a dead end, with the Quarg having inexplicably vanished.|490|0
units.english: You see one Quarg turn a sharp corner in what's a haste by their standards. When you look into the corridor it went to, you see it's a dead end, with the Quarg having inexplicably vanished.
units.italian: Vedi un Quarg svoltare a un angolo stretto a quella che, per i loro standard, è una gran fretta. Quando guardi nel corridoio in cui è entrato, scopri che è un vicolo cieco: il Quarg è svanito inspiegabilmente.
